headline: S&P Global places Nvidia's rating on negative watch over management and corporate governance risks
summary: S&P Global Ratings placed Nvidia's credit rating on CreditWatch Negative, signalling a high likelihood of a downgrade. The move reflects rising management and corporate governance risks.
why: Nvidia is the leading supplier of AI accelerator chips, and its credit rating affects its cost of debt and investor perception of governance.

impacts.name: Nvidia
impacts.why: A CreditWatch placement signals a possible rating downgrade tied to governance and management risk.
